audit.why: FAVOURED 4/10 fits: TF is immobile with weak levels 1-2, Sylas wins every stage per packet and content; TF's threat is Destiny roams, not the lane.

Spikes accurate: level 3 all-in combo, level 6 Kingslayer burst (Hijacking Destiny optional), first-item delete window, late Abduct picks. Both chart layers agree on Sylas all seven rows and match the packet.

audit.whatIsWrong: The missing-interactions file flags that TF's combo opens with an auto-attack reset (Pick a Card W) — the wind-up after the card lock, not the cast, is the step-back cue; the page never says it. Also no digits in breakdown.cooldowns and two copy-paste bleeds.
audit.why: Kit: W is 6s flat with autoReset flag; Q Wild Cards 6s; Destiny 170/140/110 vs Hijack 80/55/30. Sylas E projectile recast can be body-blocked but no wall champion here.
audit.corrected: Auto-reset tell written into breakdown.cooldowns; bleeds replaced with grounded advice; cooldown numbers added.

audit.why: W 6s and R 170s are the tracked windows.

edits.before: Twisted Fate wins by landing Pick a Card (Gold), denying your pattern, and keeping the fight at a distance your kit resents.
edits.after: Twisted Fate wins by stunning your E commit with a gold card, chipping with Wild Cards, and cashing Destiny roams bot.

edits.before: - Twisted Fate Pick a Card (Gold): matchup-defining — The locked gold card starts every trade and gank — back off the moment it glows yellow. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget E Abscond (shield-dash) for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Pick a Card is 6s flat and an auto-reset: the wind-up after the lock is your step-back cue, not the cast. Gold card spent means 6 safe seconds. - Destiny is 170s at rank 1 to your 80s Hijack. - Budget your 13s E for emergencies and the R for opportunities.

edits.before: E-shield in, E2-chain, Q-W with whirls between, heal out — the full brawl string he answered with one rotation and regret.
edits.after: His W is a 6s auto-reset — once the stun card is spent he has nothing to answer your E2 chain, so go the instant it lands on a minion.

edits.before: Chaining into a loaded CC with W down — Sylas without the heal is a mage who chose melee for the aesthetic.
edits.after: W Kingslayer heals hardest when you are low — but only when it is up; without it his cards win the burst race.
